summary: Tested SideLamps decorative diyas feature on Rishabh & Ritul wedding site. All acceptance criteria met: 3 medallions per side on desktop (1440x900) at left=12px & right edges, all 6 diya images loaded (naturalWidth=1024), fixed position with pointer-events:none and z-index:5, lamps remain fixed while scrolling, GET DIRECTIONS remains clickable (elementFromPoint returned venue-information, not lamp), lamps hidden on mobile (390x844, display:none), no horizontal overflow (scrollW=clientW=390), floating petals present, envelope intro opens via TAP TO OPEN, and zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: SideLamps.tsx is clean, small (44 lines), uses proper data-testid, aria-hidden, and pointer-events none — no issues found.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SideLamps feature verified on desktop (visible with 3 medallions per side, all images loaded, fixed position, no click interception) and mobile (hidden below 1150px, no horizontal overflow). Envelope intro and petals regression passed. No issues found.
